questions: Should the bar chart use a specific order for the categories (e.g., as provided in the list, sorted alphabetically, sorted by value)?
What should be the orientation of the bars (vertical or horizontal)?
Should the plot have any specific styling (e.g., color palette, bar width, edge color) beyond the default seaborn barplot?
Is there a required figure size or aspect ratio for the plot?
How should duplicate category names in the input list be handled (e.g., aggregate values, raise error, allow duplicates)?
Should the y-axis have a specific label or formatting (e.g., 'Value' as label, automatic scaling)?
Is the function expected to show the plot (e.g., plt.show()) or just return the Axes object without displaying?
What should happen if the input list is empty? Return empty DataFrame/Axes, raise an error, or something else?
